name: Edamame
siboNotes: Start with small portions as GOS can feed bacterial overgrowth. Monitor tolerance carefully during reintroduction phase.
preparationTips: Steam or boil in pods for 3-5 minutes until tender
Season with salt or low-FODMAP herbs after cooking
Buy frozen edamame for convenience - nutritionally equivalent to fresh
Remove from pods before eating for easier portion control
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
High in folate and vitamin K
